name: router
description: react-router-dom 7: root layout route, typed route constants, error and 404 pages
postInstall: Render <RouterProvider router={router} /> in src/main.tsx — do not wrap it in AppShell: the shell is the root layout route in src/App.tsx
Set the app title and nav items in src/App.tsx
Add lazy feature routes in src/lib/router.tsx, path constants in src/lib/routes.ts
Call useDocumentTitle("<Seite>") in every page; give each page a <PageHeader>
An app with its own router setup keeps it, but adds the ErrorBoundary (RouteError), the "*" route (NotFound) and HydrateFallback
